summary: Assess climate exposure, prioritize suppliers and routes, and develop continuity actions. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: Climate-resilient supply chain continuity planning helps procurement, supply-chain, continuity and risk leaders translate climate exposure into operational decisions. Participants practise mapping dependencies, assessing supplier and route criticality, setting disruption triggers, comparing recovery options and linking adaptation choices to procurement controls, culminating in a draft continuity action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or govern supplier, route, infrastructure and continuity decisions affected by climate-related disruption. It suits managers with working responsibility for operational plans, procurement controls or resilience priorities.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of supply-chain, procurement, business-continuity, risk or infrastructure operations is expected. No coding is required.
